keyboard.scope: Actual native keyboard focus, step boundaries, speed limits, mute/play and model-switch state. This extends the player journey; it does not replace whole-image or all-sound acceptance.
keyboard.driver: tools/mobile_native.mjs installMobileUI; same actions for original and candidate
keyboard.preparation: Task-owned Safari private window, default UA, observed 375x667/98%/2x. Select Claude; pause, idle off, preseason, click 1x, enable sound when muted, click player help text and observe player region focus.
follow_up: AX-click Play then press Space; preserve the actual focus result. Safari pointer activation did not focus that button, so this attempt alone does not prove native button keyboard handling.
Click primary Home then M; collect actual outside-player focus and unchanged sound.
Select GPT-6.1 sol and Claude Opus 5.5 with prepare=false; observe automatic playback and retain unstable timeline snapshots.
Re-prepare paused Claude; focus player help and press Tab, then re-focus help and press Option-Tab. Press Space on the actually focused native button.

capture.measurement: Complete phone viewport in the observed 98% private Safari window, in native-export coordinates; both sides use this same window.

channels.scope: All eight observed AI channels and their eight main views, through actual desktop UI. This does not certify every match/story expansion, prediction stage, sound or complete visual fidelity.
channels.preparation: Same owned Safari private window in ordinary desktop mode. Preserve full original share query. Select Live before each model; pause, idle off, preseason, 1x, actual scroll origin. Static views retain actual observed match-day state.
channels.table_observation: Keep original partial AX ranges. Scroll by real viewport pages to expose rows. Preserve every raw before/after AX and screenshot; independently check observed row coverage. Non-table omission stops capture.

capture.measurement: Complete ordinary Safari browser content below its observed 104-pixel toolbar, in unmodified native-export coordinates.
